title: Jabeen's hair oil
text: Golden oil and slow pours that land on the bottle and the brand
idea: Warm gold light, leaves and slow pours of oil suggest richness and nourishment before the bottle appears. The ad finishes on the bottle and the Jabeen's name.
why: Slow liquid motion makes the oil feel thick and premium.
Natural props (leaves, warm light) carry the herbal message without text.
Brand and bottle get the final, longest shot.
